canevents:admin-mm-help-title: Murder Mystery: how the weapon spawns work
canevents:admin-mm-help-text:
- The event config names an ordinary item to drop (Item dropped) - no new item needed.
- Players collect it; every "Needed for a bow" of them turns into the reward below (a bow and arrows by default). Leftovers above the price stay in the bag.
- Until then it is a real item they carry - it can be dropped, or looted off a body.
- Spots marked here are the only places it can appear; one is chosen at random.
- Never two tokens within "Min distance apart" of each other, so one corner cannot pile up a stash while the rest of the arena stays empty.
- Timing is "First spawn", then every "Every (s)".
- Anything left lying at the end of the match is taken back off the arena.

canevents:admin-mm-tip-penalty: What happens to a sheriff who shoots an innocent: die for it, lose the bow for a while, or nothing.
canevents:admin-mm-tip-disarm-slowness: Speed multiplier while disarmed; between 0 and 1.
canevents:admin-mm-tip-item: Any ordinary item code - no new item has to be made. Empty turns the spawns off.
canevents:admin-mm-tip-per-spawn: How many go into one drop. Usually 1 - the point is walking to the next spot.
canevents:admin-mm-tip-required:
Collect this many and the reward is handed over automatically.
Leftovers stay in the bag: 12 with a price of 10 buys one bow and keeps two.
canevents:admin-mm-tip-min-distance:
Never a second token within this many blocks of one already lying there,
so a single corner cannot become a stash.
canevents:admin-mm-tip-lifetime: 0 = it waits until someone takes it.
canevents:admin-mm-reward-title: Murder Mystery: what finding the tokens pays
canevents:admin-mm-reward-hint: Handed over for every "Needed for a bow" tokens collected. Part of the settings: press Save settings to keep changes.
canevents:admin-mm-reward-empty: Nothing listed: collecting the tokens pays nothing.
canevents:admin-help-subtitle: F7 opens or closes this panel. Needs the controlserver privilege.
canevents:admin-help-click-hint: Click a heading to expand or collapse it.
canevents:admin-help-qs-1: Go to the 'New Arena' tab and pick the event you want to run.
canevents:admin-help-qs-2: It walks you through every step that event needs (place, bounds, spawn points, mode setup, enable) and ticks them off in the Steps list as you go.
canevents:admin-help-qs-3: On the last step the event shows 'ready' once a match can be placed: press 'Start <event> now' there (starts from whoever is queued), or open registration with 'Open' on the Events tab.
canevents:admin-help-qs-hint-1: Arenas is where you edit what already exists: sub-tabs List, Place (spawns, bounds) and Mode setup.
canevents:admin-help-qs-hint-2: Actions print a status line at the bottom of the panel; the 'Log' button at its right end keeps the recent ones.
canevents:admin-help-where-dashboard: Dashboard - Auto-scheduler (on/off, interval, open registrations with Start now / Cancel), Running matches with 'Stop all matches', Recent actions.
canevents:admin-help-where-events: Events - every event with its Ready state (and why not), the signup window length, and per event: Open (registration), Start now, Cancel, Enable / Disable.
canevents:admin-help-where-arenas: Arenas - the places themselves, in sub-tabs. List: click a row to select a place; Ctrl+click (or the row's box) builds a bulk selection to enable, disable, add/remove a type or delete at once. Place: the selected place's Go to, outline, spawn points and bounds. Mode setup: hill, checkpoints, zone & loot, flag posts, weapon spots, platform - whatever its types need.
canevents:admin-help-where-newarena: New Arena - a step-by-step wizard: Choose event > Create place (or Use an existing one) > Mark bounds > Spawn points > Mode setup > Enable > Done.
canevents:admin-help-where-content: Content - sub-tabs Loadouts, Outfits, Templates, Schematics.
canevents:admin-help-where-economy: Economy - sub-tabs Rewards (per-event payouts, entry fee, payout settings) and Limits (server-wide anti-farm limits and the server default reward; 'Edit' on the Rewards tab's default reward card leads there).
canevents:admin-help-where-tournaments: Tournaments - Setup (list, Control card: open/close signup, begin, call the next match, cancel; Editor: Settings / Events & arenas / Payouts) and Bracket (left-click a match for details, right-click opens the side panel to declare a winner or disqualify).
canevents:admin-help-where-players: Players - allow or revoke spectating, blacklist from the event queue.
canevents:admin-help-where-debug: Debug - server state (pause the scheduler, stop all matches), try an event against bots, fill a tournament with bots or call its next match.
canevents:admin-help-concepts-intro: CAN Events has four core concepts:
canevents:admin-help-concepts-event: Event - a game mode definition (e.g. '1x1', 'deathmatch'). Read from JSON in ModConfig/canevents/events/, which is seeded from the mod's assets/canevents/config/events/ on first run.
canevents:admin-help-concepts-place: Place - a physical arena in the world. You create these in-game; they are saved to disk per server.
canevents:admin-help-concepts-template: Template - a schematic + place recipe. Lets you stamp a pre-built arena anywhere with a click.
canevents:admin-help-concepts-loadout: Loadout - a named gear set. 'Inline' loadouts come from event JSON; 'Managed' loadouts are edited in-game and override inline ones.
canevents:admin-help-concepts-types: An event runs on any place that has all the types the event requires, e.g. event '1x1' requires type ARENA1X1. The New Arena wizard tags a place for the event you pick; on Arenas > List the bulk bar adds or removes types.
canevents:admin-help-bounds-intro: Bounds are a place's footprint, marked from two opposite corners. They are NOT a barrier - nothing stops a player walking out of them. What they actually do:
canevents:admin-help-bounds-1: Address the place: /canep commands act on whichever place contains you (X/Z only, height ignored).
canevents:admin-help-bounds-2: Define the Spleef platform's size and floor level.
canevents:admin-help-bounds-3: Provide a fallback centre when a KOTH hill or Hunger Games zone was never set.
canevents:admin-help-bounds-4: Optionally lay down two spawn points on opposite sides: tick 'Replace spawn points with 2 on opposite sides' before 'Set bounds' (/canep mark2 adds them only when the place has none).
canevents:admin-help-bounds-outro: Bounds are set on Arenas > Place (and in the wizard's Mark bounds step): Mark 1, Mark 2, then 'Set bounds'. Clicking a place on Arenas > List draws its outline in the world; 'Hide outline' in the status line clears it.
canevents:admin-help-wf-1v1-1: New Arena tab > click event '1x1' > name it > 'Create the place'.
canevents:admin-help-wf-1v1-2: Mark bounds: Mark 1 / Mark 2 on opposite floor corners > 'Set bounds'. Spawn points: 'Add spawn point at my position' once per side. Then Enable.
canevents:admin-help-wf-1v1-3: Events tab > 'Open' starts a registration window (everyone online gets a Join popup); players can also queue from the events browser (K by default).
canevents:admin-help-wf-dm-2: Add one spawn point per team, standing where that team should start (order = team 1, 2, ...).
canevents:admin-help-wf-dm-3: Content > Loadouts > Set editor: pull gear in with '+ Hotbar' / '+ Armor', pick 'deathmatch' in Event, type a Set name, 'Save set' - or rely on the inline JSON sets.
canevents:admin-help-wf-spleef-1: New Arena tab > pick a spleef event. Bounds should wrap the destructible PLATFORM, not the whole room.
canevents:admin-help-wf-spleef-2: Arenas > Mode setup > Spleef card > 'Edit platform', set Radius and Block, fill with 'Fill square' / 'Fill circle' / 'Flood fill', then 'Save' ('Cancel' discards the session).
canevents:admin-help-wf-spleef-3: Optional: set the cage size (W / D / H) and Block, stand in its centre and press '+Cage' - a cage (glass by default) that keeps players from griefing the surroundings.
canevents:admin-help-wf-spleef-4: Spawns: add one per side, or tick 'Replace spawn points with 2 on opposite sides' before 'Set bounds' to get two on opposite edges.
canevents:admin-help-wf-koth-1: New Arena tab > pick event 'koth'. Add one spawn point per team (2-4 teams).
canevents:admin-help-wf-koth-2: Arenas > Mode setup (or the wizard's Mode setup step) > King of the Hill card: set Radius and Height, stand on the hill > 'Set hill at the block under my feet'.
canevents:admin-help-wf-koth-3: The block under your feet is the center. Stored as BehaviorData['KingOfTheHill'] = {{ X, Y, Z, Radius, Height }}.
canevents:admin-help-wf-koth-4: Without a hill set, the place's bounds center is used instead: the card says 'NO HILL SET' and the List's Setup column shows 'H!'.
canevents:admin-help-wf-koth-5: The team outnumbering all others inside the zone scores; equal numbers score nothing.
canevents:admin-help-wf-parkour-1: New Arena tab > pick event 'parkour'. Templates auto-derive bounds from the schematic.
canevents:admin-help-wf-parkour-2: Arenas > Mode setup > Parkour card: 'Mark next checkpoint (block under my feet)' along the course, 'Mark finish' last.
canevents:admin-help-wf-parkour-3: Lives: type them in the Lives field > 'Apply lives' (unset = the event's default). To renumber a checkpoint, type the number in Index and press 'Set index' on its row; 'Remove' deletes one.
canevents:admin-help-wf-parkour-4: Spawn point = the course start: stand there and add it in the wizard's Spawn points step (or '+Spawn' on Arenas > Place).
canevents:admin-help-wf-ctf-1: New Arena tab > pick event 'ctf'. Add one spawn point per team (2 teams).
canevents:admin-help-wf-ctf-2: Arenas > Mode setup > Capture the Flag card: type the team in Team, stand on its post > 'Set the team's post at the block under my feet'; repeat for the other team.
canevents:admin-help-wf-ctf-3: Or in chat: /canep ctfpost <team> (1-based) at the block under your feet.
canevents:admin-help-wf-ctf-4: Flags render on the posts; carry the enemy flag home while yours is in place.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-intro: Battle royale: one life each, loot from chests on the map, a storm ring that shrinks until one tribute is left. Placement is by how long you survived, not by kills.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-fast-1: New Arena tab > pick event 'hungergames' > mark bounds around the playable area.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-fast-2: Card 'One-click layout and preview' (Spawn points step, Mode setup step, or Arenas > Mode setup): stand at the arena centre, set Layout radius and Spawns, press 'Generate full layout here' - a ring of spawns, the zone centre and all loot spots (cornucopia in the middle, mid ring, outer ring) in one click.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-fast-3: 'Snap to ground: on' follows uneven terrain; switch it to off for a flat schematic floor, and for a roofed arena (it would snap onto the roof).
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-fast-4: Over an existing layout the button turns into 'Confirm: replace layout' - a second click overwrites it.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-hand-1: Spawns (pedestals) card: '+ Spawn at my position'; per row 'Move here' and 'Remove'. One per tribute (12 by default); fewer is allowed - tributes then share pedestals.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-hand-2: Zone card: 'Set zone here' (centre at your feet, radius from Zone radius), 'Apply radius' (keeps the centre) or 'Fit to bounds'. The dome may reach past the bounds if you want it to.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-hand-3: Loot spots card: pick a tier with the buttons after 'Loot tier:' (its contents are listed under them; the block under your feet is highlighted in the tier's colour), then 'Add loot spot here'.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-hand-4: Each spot in the list has 'TP', 'Tier' (pick another tier) and 'Remove'; 'Clear all loot spots' empties the list.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-hand-5: Without a zone set, the place's bounds center is used instead.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-check-1: The checklist on the Hunger Games card flags missing bounds/spawns/zone/loot/cornucopia, and the lines under it warn about spawns outside the zone and similar pitfalls.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-check-2: 'World preview: on' draws the dome, phase circles, spawns and loot as server particles - players standing nearby see them too.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-check-3: Zone phases and loot tables are edited on the card 'Loot tables & zone phases (advanced)': 'Save config' writes the event JSON, 'Apply to all variants: on' writes every Hunger Games event at once.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-check-4: Phase sizes are a percent of the arena's zone radius, so one schedule fits every arena.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-check-5: Feast, sponsor drops, grace period and the opening freeze live in event_hungergames.json.
canevents:admin-help-wf-hg-check-6: hungergames_solotest runs the whole thing solo at 3x speed - use it to test an arena.
canevents:admin-help-wf-jugg-1: Runs on DEATHMATCH-tagged places - reuse an existing deathmatch arena.
canevents:admin-help-wf-jugg-2: FFA with respawns; one player holds the crown (bonus HP + damage).
canevents:admin-help-wf-jugg-3: Tweak crown bonuses / scoreLimit in event_juggernaut.json.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-dmg-1: sheriffBowDamage / murdererBowDamage set what an arrow is worth per role; bowDamage is the fallback for both, murdererMeleeDamage covers the knife.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-dmg-2: 0 leaves the item's own damage alone.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-dmg-3: Edit it on Arenas > Mode setup > card 'Murder Mystery: settings (event config)', group 'Weapon damage' (Sheriff's bow, Murderer's bow, Any bow (fallback), Murderer's melee) - pick the variant under 'Event:' first - or in event_murdermystery.json.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-dmg-4: 'Save settings' writes the event JSON in ModConfig and applies to the next match.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-spawn-1: bowPickupItem ('Item dropped', group 'Weapon spawns') names an ORDINARY item to drop - no new item needs making; 'Held item as token' takes the one in your hand.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-spawn-2: Players collect it: every bowPickupRequired of them ('Needed for a bow', 10 by default) is exchanged for the items in bowPickupReward - any list, edited on the card 'Murder Mystery: what finding the tokens pays' (a bow and arrows in the shipped config). Leftovers above the price stay in the bag.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-spawn-3: Carried parts are real items: they drop on death and can be looted.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-spawn-4: Timers: bowPickupFirstSeconds ('First spawn (s)'), then every bowPickupIntervalSeconds ('Every (s)').
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-spawn-5: bowPickupMaxActive ('Max lying around') caps how many lie around; bowPickupMinDistance ('Min distance apart') keeps two of them apart, so one corner cannot become a stash.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-spawn-6: bowPickupLifetimeSeconds ('Expires after (s)') expires an untouched one (0 = it waits).
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-spawn-7: bowPickupMakesSheriff ('Finder becomes the sheriff') turns an innocent finder into the sheriff.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-mark-1: Arenas > Mode setup > card 'Murder Mystery: weapon spots' > 'Mark a spot under my feet' (per row 'Remove', 'Clear all spots' for all), or /canep mmpickup.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-mark-2: Marked spots are drawn in the world in yellow while the place is selected.
canevents:admin-help-wf-mm-mark-3: No spots marked = no weapon spawns; the mode plays as it always did.
canevents:admin-help-wf-sched-2: Interval: the 5m / 10m / 15m / 30m / 60m buttons (the current one is pressed). Events rotate through the configured list, shown as 'Rotation:'; Debug > 'Pause scheduler' holds it without turning it off.
canevents:admin-help-wf-sched-3: Or use /eventadmin schedule on / off / interval <minutes> in chat.
canevents:admin-help-wf-loadouts-1: Inline = sets defined in event JSON. Always present; treated as fallback.
canevents:admin-help-wf-loadouts-2: Managed = sets built in the Set editor on Content > Loadouts (quantity: click an item in the list, then change the Quantity field under it). Stored in ModConfig/canevents/loadouts/<eventCode>.json; outfits (Content > Outfits) work the same way in outfits/.
canevents:admin-help-wf-loadouts-3: If managed sets exist for an event, they REPLACE inline sets entirely (not merged).
canevents:admin-help-wf-loadouts-4: 'Import from JSON' in the Set editor copies the inline sets of the event picked in Event into managed storage so you can tweak them; 'Load into editor' on a listed set opens it for editing.
canevents:admin-help-wf-loadouts-5: Players see a popup at match start to pick a set if more than one exists; they can save a default.
canevents:admin-help-wf-templates-1: Content > Schematics > 'Create Template' on a schematic's row > Template code, tick the Event types, optionally On Demand > 'Create'.
canevents:admin-help-wf-templates-2: Content > Templates > 'Place Here' stamps the schematic at your position and creates a Place.
canevents:admin-help-wf-templates-3: 'Edit' places it temporarily; the 'Editing: <code>' card under the list has 'Add Spawn Here', 'Clear', 'Save', 'Cancel & Restore' and 'Finish (keep)'.
canevents:admin-help-wf-templates-4: On Demand templates (Mode 'on-demand' in the list) are placed at event start and removed when the event ends.
canevents:admin-help-ts-noplace-title: "No place found" when starting an event
canevents:admin-help-ts-noplace-text: The event needs a place tagged with all of its required types that is enabled and has spawn points. The Ready column of the Events tab says which part is missing ('no arena', 'arena off', 'no spawns', 'arena busy'); hover it for details, then fix the place on Arenas (Types column, Status, Sp.).
canevents:admin-help-ts-koth-text: Hill geometry is missing, so the bounds center is being used and it may sit off the playable floor. Open the place's Mode setup tab on Arenas - the King of the Hill card says 'NO HILL SET' when there is none - stand on the intended block and press 'Set hill at the block under my feet'. Check the server log for the [KOTH] line at start.
canevents:admin-help-ts-spleef-fall-titl: Spleef: players fall through but are never out
canevents:admin-help-ts-spleef-fall-text: A player is out once they drop more than 2 blocks below the platform. Solid ground right under the platform catches them first, so the match runs to its time limit. Dig a pit (3+ blocks) under the platform. The server log warns about this at match start.
canevents:admin-help-ts-parkour-title: Parkour: nobody can reach the finish
canevents:admin-help-ts-parkour-text: Checkpoints must be passed in order. Their numbers only set the order - a match renumbers them 0, 1, 2..., so gaps or starting at 1 are fine. The Parkour card on Arenas > Mode setup lists the course in order and warns when no finish is marked.
canevents:admin-help-ts-cage-title: Spleef cage spawns inside the wrong area
canevents:admin-help-ts-cage-text: '+Cage' centres the cage on where YOU are standing, not on the place's bounds. Stand in the middle of the intended cage, then click '+Cage' again - 'Clear cage' first if one is already stored.
canevents:admin-help-ts-hg-storm-title: Hunger Games: the storm hurts everyone from the start
canevents:admin-help-ts-hg-storm-text: The zone is centred somewhere off the arena, or its radius is smaller than the spawn ring, so tributes begin outside it. Open the place's Mode setup, switch 'World preview' on and read the warnings under the Hunger Games checklist - they say when spawns start outside the zone. Re-run 'Generate full layout here', press 'Fit to bounds', or set a larger 'Zone radius' and 'Apply radius'.
canevents:admin-help-ts-hg-chests-title: Hunger Games: chests are empty or missing
canevents:admin-help-ts-hg-chests-text: A loot spot that already had a chest, sign or other block entity on it is skipped on purpose (placing there would destroy its contents) - the server log names the position. A spot marked at the wrong height ends up buried; regenerate with 'Snap to ground: on', or 'Remove' it and add it again standing on the floor. The feast only tops up chests this match placed, and only into their free slots.
canevents:admin-help-ts-loadouts-text: Check that (1) the event JSON has 'loadoutSets' or 'loadout', or (2) Content > Loadouts has at least one managed set for this event code. The set name in the player's pick must exist in the active source.
canevents:admin-help-ts-mark-text: Aim the crosshair at the corner block, THEN press F7 and click Mark 1 / Mark 2 (Bounds card on Arenas > Place, or the wizard's Mark bounds step): the aim is taken when the panel opens, because once it is open the mouse moves a cursor, not your view. Each aim is used for one Mark; after that, or if you weren't aiming at a block, the block under your feet is used. The 'Next mark: ...' line above the Mark buttons always says which block the next Mark will take; when it cannot read a position the buttons are greyed out.
canevents:admin-help-ts-item-title: Loadout item shows 'not found' in server log
canevents:admin-help-ts-item-text: The item code is wrong or the providing mod isn't loaded. Format is 'domain:code', e.g. 'game:sword-iron'. Use the creative inventory to copy the exact code.
canevents:admin-help-cmd-hint: All require the controlserver privilege. The /canep ones act on the place you stand in; the panel does the same by place id, so you can stand anywhere.
canevents:admin-help-cmd-1: /canep new | addname <n> | addtype <T> | addsp | mark1 | mark2 [replace|keep] | save - manual place creation
canevents:admin-help-cmd-3: /canep kothhill <radius> [height] - set KOTH hill at the block under your feet
canevents:admin-help-cmd-4: /canep cp [index] | cpfinish | cplist | cpremove | cpedit <idx> | cplives <n> - parkour checkpoints
canevents:admin-help-cmd-5: /canep hgzone <radius> | hgloot [tier] | hglootlist | hglootclear - Hunger Games zone and loot
canevents:admin-help-cmd-6: /canep ctfpost <team> | ctfposts | ctfclear - CTF flag posts
canevents:admin-help-cmd-7: /canep mmpickup | mmpickuplist | mmpickupremove <idx> | mmpickupclear - Murder Mystery weapon spawns
canevents:admin-help-cmd-8: /eventadmin start <eventCode> - start a match now from whoever is queued (the Start now button)
canevents:admin-help-cmd-11: /eventadmin open <eventCode> [minutes] | cancel <eventCode> | status - registration windows (the Open / Cancel buttons)
canevents:admin-players-online-hint: Everyone on the server right now. Picking one fills the name box below.
canevents:admin-players-name-hint: Exact player name, as the server last saw it. For someone offline who is not in the table below, type it here - they must have joined at least once.
canevents:admin-players-empty: Nobody online, and nobody has been granted or barred yet.
canevents:admin-players-table-hint: Everyone online, plus anyone already allowed or blacklisted. Others are left out.
canevents:admin-players-omitted: {0} more not shown - use the box above.
canevents:admin-players-role-hint: Comes from the role '{0}'. Revoking here denies it for this player only; the role keeps it.
canevents:admin-srv-hint: The main server config (ModConfig/canevents.json), edited live. Each change is checked and saved at once - no Save button, no file editing. Settings marked [restart] are saved but only take effect after a server restart. Hover a row for what it does.
canevents:admin-srv-tip-restart: Saved at once, but only takes effect after a server restart.
canevents:admin-srv-tip-pending: Changed since the server started: the new value is saved and takes effect after the next restart.
canevents:admin-srv-not-an-option: {0}: not one of the allowed values
canevents:admin-srv-bad-hotkey: {0}: not a key name (examples: K, F6, U)
canevents:admin-srv-autoscheduleenabled-: Announce events from the rotation on their own, every interval. Same switch as the Overview buttons.
canevents:admin-srv-scheduleintervalminu: Minutes between automatic announcements. Changing it restarts the countdown.
canevents:admin-srv-minplayerstostart-de: The auto-scheduler skips its turn while fewer players than this are online.
canevents:admin-srv-maxconcurrentevents-: The auto-scheduler announces nothing while this many matches are running.
canevents:admin-srv-signupwindowminutes-: Length of a registration window opened without a length (auto-schedule, Open with the default). 0 = open until an admin starts the event.
canevents:admin-srv-countdownseconds-des: Seconds from 'arena found' to the teleport in, for events without a countdown of their own. Next match on.
canevents:admin-srv-maxeventdurationseco: Time limit a match starts with; modes with their own time limit override it. Next match on.
canevents:admin-srv-queuereadychecksecon: How long a queue match waits for its players to confirm they are at the keyboard. 0 = no ready check.
canevents:admin-srv-maxlocationsearchsec: An assembled match that finds no free arena within this time is cancelled and stakes are refunded. 0 = wait forever.
canevents:admin-srv-allowfriendlyfire-de: Allow damage between teammates in every event, overriding the NoFriendlyFire behavior.
canevents:admin-srv-issuedgeardrop-desc: What happens to match-issued kit a player throws on the ground. Events can override it.
canevents:admin-srv-attemptcomposeteamse: How often the queues try to assemble matches.
canevents:admin-srv-attemptfindlocationf: How often assembled matches look for a free arena (and ready checks are resolved).
canevents:admin-srv-rankedmmrbasetoleran: Elo difference allowed within a ranked match at first.
canevents:admin-srv-rankedmmrtolerancewi: How much the allowed Elo spread widens per second the longest-waiting side has queued.
canevents:admin-srv-duelsenabled-desc: Let players challenge each other. Off refuses new challenges; running duels finish.
canevents:admin-srv-duelinvitetimeoutsec: How long a challenge waits for an answer.
canevents:admin-srv-autospectateadmins-d: Seat idle admins as observers of every match that goes live. Moves them without asking.
canevents:admin-srv-spectatortelemetryin: How often privileged observers are sent participant positions and health.
canevents:admin-srv-pinarenachunks-desc: Hold the arena's chunks in memory for the length of a match. Off: arenas may unload under a bot-only match. Next match on.
canevents:admin-srv-arenaoutlineparticle: Draw the arena border with particles during a match. Turn off first if players report the game closing during matches. Next match on.
canevents:admin-srv-arenaoutlineinterval: Seconds between outline redraws. Above 1.2 the outline blinks. Next match on.
canevents:admin-srv-maxplatformfloodfill: Safety cap on the Spleef platform flood-fill radius.
Safety cap on how many blocks one platform flood-fill may change.
canevents:admin-srv-maindialoghotkey-des: Default key of the events browser (a key name such as K). Players get it on their next login; a player's own rebind wins.
canevents:admin-srv-diagnosticslogging-d: Turn on the mod's step-by-step trace in the logs of players who log in from now on (they reconnect for it). Many lines - for chasing crashes only.
canevents:admin-srv-inventoryauditmaxent: How many inventory audit entries are kept.
canevents:admin-dash-off-hint: - events only start when you announce them by hand.
canevents:admin-dash-log-empty: Nothing yet. Actions you take here are recorded, including chat commands.
canevents:admin-events-hint: Ready tells you whether a match could be placed right now. Disabled events are hidden from the event browser.
canevents:admin-events-signup-explain: -1 = server default from the config;  0 = open until you press Start now
canevents:admin-events-signup-help:
How long "Open" keeps registration open. Everyone online gets a popup with a Join button and the countdown, and the match starts when the time is up - or earlier if the lobby fills.

-1 uses the server's default window from the config.
0 keeps it open until you press "Start now" yourself.
canevents:admin-events-places-tip:
Needs a place tagged: {0}
Spawn points wanted: {1}
canevents:admin-events-busy-tip: {0}. It will be free once those matches end.
canevents:admin-events-nospawns-tip: {0}. Select it in Arenas and add spawn points.
canevents:admin-events-rotation-on-tip: Not in the auto-schedule rotation. Click to add it (applies at once, no restart).
canevents:admin-events-rotation-off-tip: In the auto-schedule rotation. Click to take it out (applies at once, no restart).

canevents:rotation-already-in: {0} is already in the rotation. Rotation: {1}.
canevents:rotation-not-in: {0} is not in the rotation. Rotation: {1}.
canevents:admin-events-incomplete-tip: {0}. Finish the mode setup in Arenas → Mode setup.
canevents:admin-arenas-edit-info-tip: Rename this place, describe it and change its tags.
canevents:admin-place-info-tags: Tags - an event runs only on places carrying all of its tags
canevents:quiet-on: Quiet mode on: you won't get server-wide event announcements or signup popups. Your own queue and matches still message you. /canquiet off to undo.
canevents:quiet-off: Quiet mode off: event announcements and signup popups are back.
canevents:wand-help: Mode: {0}. Right click a block to mark it on the selected place (or the one whose bounds hold it), sneak + right click to remove. Change the mode with /canep wand <mode>: {1}.
canevents:wand-no-place: No place to mark ({0}, {1}, {2}) on: select one with /canep select <id>, or click inside a place's bounds.
canevents:wand-nothing-here: Nothing of this mode on that block.
canevents:wand-mode-is: The wand in your hand is in mode '{0}'.
canevents:wand-given: Here is the event wand (mode '{0}'). Right click marks, sneak + right click removes.
canevents:admin-no-privilege: The event admin panel needs the controlserver privilege.
canevents:setup-gap-koth-hill: no KOTH hill and no bounds to fall back on
canevents:setup-gap-hg-zone: no storm centre and no bounds to fall back on
canevents:admin-events-eventoff-tip: This event is disabled. Enable it to let players queue.
canevents:admin-events-noarena-tip:
No place carries the tags {0}.
Build one in the New Arena tab.
canevents:admin-events-open-tip:
Opens registration for the window set above.
Everyone online gets a popup with a Join button; the match starts when the time is up.
canevents:admin-events-start-now-tip:
Starts a match right now from whoever is already queued.
Fails if the queue is empty.
canevents:admin-events-cancel-tip: Closes the open registration window without starting anything.
canevents:admin-events-enable-tip: Lets players queue for this event and shows it in the event browser.
canevents:admin-events-disable-tip: Hides this event from the event browser; nobody can queue for it.
canevents:admin-debug-state-hint: Testing tools. Bot matches never touch Elo or the leaderboard.
canevents:admin-debug-pause-tip: A running tournament pauses the auto-scheduler when configured to.
canevents:admin-debug-stop-all-tip: Ends every live match on the server. Asks for a second click.
canevents:admin-debug-bots-tip-play: You plus this many bot sides.
canevents:admin-debug-bots-tip-solo: This many bot sides, without you.
canevents:admin-debug-bots-tip:
Enough of them to satisfy the mode's minimum or it will end as soon as it starts.

The match runs on a throwaway copy of the event: bots are grown into it, and rewards, the entry fee and rating are all off. The event's own config is untouched.
canevents:admin-debug-part-tip:
Play: you are in the line-up, fighting the bots.

Watch: bots only, and you are seated as an observer as soon as it has an arena - the quick way to look at the spectator HUD and the broadcast camera.

Leave running: bots only and you are not touched at all. Use this to test joining the ordinary way afterwards, from the browser or /canspectate.

The last two need at least two bots: with you out of the line-up, they are the only sides there are.
canevents:admin-debug-too-few-bots: needs at least 2 bots without you
canevents:admin-debug-force-start-tip: Starts this event from whoever is queued for it right now, ignoring the minimum. Nothing to do with bots.
canevents:admin-debug-tour-empty-hint: Create one on the Tournaments tab.
canevents:admin-debug-tour-bots-tip: Bots cannot pay an entry fee, so a tournament with one configured will refuse them.
canevents:admin-debug-call-next-tip: Ignores the parallel-match limit. If nothing can be called it says why - someone offline, no free arena.
canevents:admin-debug-bots-before-start: Bots can only be added before the bracket starts.
canevents:admin-debug-call-while-running: Matches can only be called while the bracket is running.
canevents:admin-debug-log-empty: Nothing yet. Actions you take here are recorded, including chat commands.
canevents:admin-content-loadouts-hint: Gear handed to players at match start. Sets edited here override the ones in event JSON. Several sets on one event become a choice players make before the match.
canevents:admin-content-outfits-hint: Plain clothes worn over the loadout, so players can be told apart and described. One set = one outfit; each player gets a different one.
canevents:admin-content-sets-empty-hint: Build one in the editor, or use 'Import from JSON' to copy an event's inline sets into editable ones.
canevents:admin-content-upgrades-tip: Match-point upgrade chains of this kit's items (separate window)
canevents:admin-content-upg-none: No levels. Hold the next level's item and press + Level from hand.
canevents:admin-content-upg-qty-tip: Qty 0 = as many as the kit item.
canevents:admin-kitupg-hint: Each level is bought with match points and takes the previous one's place in the same slot. Bought levels last until the match ends.
canevents:admin-kitupg-extra-add: + extra item for this level from hand
canevents:admin-kitupg-extra-tip: Extras (rows with +) come with the level and go when the next one is bought.
canevents:admin-kitupg-loading: The kit list is still loading, press again.
canevents:admin-content-detail-none: Click a set in the list above to see its items.
canevents:admin-content-load-tip:
Copies this set into the editor.
Saving under the same name overwrites it.
canevents:admin-content-item-unknown: This client does not know this item code, so it has no icon.
canevents:admin-content-editor-hint-set: Equip the gear you want, then pull it in from your own inventory.
canevents:admin-content-editor-hint-outf: Put the clothes on, then pull them in from what you are wearing.
canevents:admin-content-add-hotbar-tip: Adds everything in your hotbar to the list below.
canevents:admin-content-add-armor-tip: Adds what you are currently wearing.
canevents:admin-content-add-held-tip: Adds the item in your hand.
canevents:admin-content-pending-empty-se: List is empty. Use + Hotbar / + Armor.
canevents:admin-content-pending-empty-ou: List is empty. Wear the clothes and use + Armor.
canevents:admin-content-qty-pick: Click an item in the list to change its quantity.
canevents:admin-content-save-missing: Pick an event and type a set name to save.
canevents:admin-content-import-tip-set:
Copies the loadout sets defined in this event's JSON into editable ones,
so you can tweak them here instead of editing files.
canevents:admin-content-import-tip-outfi:
Copies the outfits defined in this event's JSON into editable ones,
so you can tweak them here instead of editing files.
canevents:admin-content-tpl-hint: A template is a prebuilt arena: schematic plus spawn points and types. 'Place Here' stamps it into the world and registers it as a ready place.
canevents:admin-content-tpl-empty-hint: Add arena template JSON files to ModConfig/canevents/arenas/ and schematic files to ModConfig/canevents/schematics/ (or create one from a schematic in the Schematics tab).
canevents:admin-content-tpl-place-tip: Builds this arena at your position and registers it as a place.
canevents:admin-content-tpl-edit-tip: Places it temporarily so you can adjust its spawn points, then save back to the template.
canevents:admin-content-log-import: > import sets from the event config: {0}
canevents:admin-content-sch-hint: Raw building files from ModConfig/canevents/schematics/. A schematic is just geometry; turn it into a template to give it event types and spawns.
canevents:admin-content-sch-empty-hint: Export a build with the game's worldedit tools, then drop the .json into ModConfig/canevents/schematics/ and hit Refresh.
canevents:admin-content-sch-ondemand: On Demand (blocks appear only during the event)
canevents:admin-content-sch-create-tip: Needs a template code and at least one event type.
canevents:admin-economy-event-hint: Per-event payouts and entry fee, saved back to the event's JSON in ModConfig. Fields left on 'inherit' follow the Limits tab.
canevents:admin-economy-dirty-question: The edits to '{0}' are not saved. Switch to '{1}' and throw them away?
canevents:admin-economy-reload-hint: Asks the server for the saved config again, replacing what is shown here.
canevents:admin-economy-unsaved: Unsaved edits to '{0}' - Save sends this event only.
canevents:admin-economy-saved: '{0}': no unsaved edits. Save sends this event only.
canevents:admin-economy-hold-first: Hold the item you want to use first.
canevents:admin-economy-set-add-place-hi: Adds a reward for the next finishing place. Filling places in replaces the flat Winner reward.
canevents:admin-economy-set-winner-hint: Given to everyone on the winning side.
canevents:admin-economy-set-participatio: Given to players who did NOT win, just for taking part.
canevents:admin-economy-set-fee-hint: Charged when a player queues. All stakes form a pot paid to the winner(s).
canevents:admin-economy-set-place-hint: Paid to whoever finishes in place {0}. Needs an event that produces a finishing order (FFA by kills, Parkour by time, Spleef by elimination order, team modes by team score); modes that cannot be ranked fall back to the flat Winner reward.
canevents:admin-economy-places-active: Rewards by place are set: the Winner reward is IGNORED for this event. Remove every place to go back to it.
canevents:admin-economy-places-none: No rewards by place: this flat set is paid. Add places to pay 1st/2nd/3rd differently - that replaces it.
canevents:admin-economy-participation-of: Participation is switched off for this event (settings on the right): this set is not paid.
canevents:admin-economy-inherit-default: Empty: falls back to the server default shown above (greyed). Add items to override it.
canevents:admin-economy-inherit-none: Empty and no server default set - this event pays nothing here.
canevents:admin-economy-inherit-unknown: Empty: falls back to the server default (not loaded yet).
canevents:admin-economy-fee-free: No fee set - this event is free to enter.
canevents:admin-economy-place-empty: Nothing set for this place yet.
canevents:admin-economy-remove-place-hin: Removes this place; the ones after it move up.
canevents:admin-economy-items-unknown: This client does not know the item. It may exist on the server (another mod), but check the spelling.
canevents:admin-economy-items-edit-hint: Loads the item into the line below: change the quantity, then press Add / update.
canevents:admin-economy-items-add-hint: Adds the item. If the code is already listed, sets its quantity instead.
canevents:admin-economy-items-hotbar-hin: Adds everything in your hotbar. An item already listed gets the hotbar's count on top.
canevents:admin-economy-items-held-hint: Adds the item in your active hotbar slot, with its stack size as the quantity.
canevents:admin-economy-items-clear-hint: Empties this set. Nothing is sent until you press Save.
canevents:admin-economy-tip-participatio:
inherit - use the server-wide setting from the Limits tab.
on - always pay it here, even if the server default is off.
off - never pay it here, even if the server default is on.

'off' is a decision that sticks: change the global setting later and this event keeps ignoring it. 'inherit' would follow it.
canevents:admin-economy-tip-rake:
Share of the pot destroyed before payout.
0 = the winner takes the whole pot.
100 = the entire pot is burned (a pure entry barrier, the normal reward still applies).
canevents:admin-economy-fee-summary-free: No fee set - this event is free to enter.
canevents:admin-economy-fee-summary-all: Fee set: the winner takes the whole pot.
canevents:admin-economy-fee-summary-spli: Fee set: winners split {0}% of the pot.
canevents:admin-economy-tip-minmatch:
Matches shorter than this pay no winner reward (participation still applies).
Stops two players from queueing, instantly conceding, and farming the payout.
canevents:admin-economy-tip-minmatch-sec: This event's own minimum, in seconds. 0 = no minimum for this event.
canevents:admin-economy-tip-ratecap-exem:
The rate-cap limits how often one player can be paid for winning.
on - this event always pays, no matter how often they win it (use for tournaments).
off / inherit - the cap applies.
canevents:admin-economy-tip-own-budget:
on - wins here count against a budget of their own.
off / inherit - they share one budget with every other event.

Give a busy event its own budget so winning it does not exhaust the player's allowance everywhere else.
canevents:admin-economy-override-tip: Overrides the global setting: an explicit choice keeps its value even if the global one changes later.
canevents:admin-economy-defaults-warn: Applies to EVERY event that leaves the matching set empty.
canevents:admin-economy-defaults-hint: One item each. For multi-item payouts, fill the per-event sets on the Rewards tab.
canevents:admin-economy-defaults-edit-hi: Opens the Limits tab, where the server defaults are edited and saved.
canevents:admin-economy-def-participatio: In brackets: whether events left on 'inherit' pay it.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-hint: How often and how easily rewards can be earned, server-wide. An event follows these unless it overrides them on the Rewards tab - that is what 'inherit' means. Edits stay here until you press Save.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-save-hint: Saves every limit and the server default reward. Affects all events.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-reload-hint: Asks the server for the saved limits again, replacing what is shown here.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-unsaved: Unsaved edits - affects all events once saved.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-tip-burst: How many rewards a player may collect back-to-back before the refill timer gates them.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-tip-refill: How long it takes to earn back one slot of that burst.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-tip-per-event: On: farming one event does not eat the allowance for the others.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-tip-minmatch: Stops two players trading wins in instant matches: shorter matches pay no winner reward.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-refund: Refund a forfeited stake on a void match
canevents:admin-economy-lm-tip-refund: When a match ends void, a stake that was forfeited is given back.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-participation: Pay a participation reward by default
canevents:admin-economy-lm-tip-participa: Used by every event whose Participation is set to 'inherit'.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-tip-code: For codes holding the item cannot give: an item this client lacks, or a code from another server. Otherwise use the 'Held' buttons on the right.
canevents:admin-economy-lm-held-hint: Takes whatever you are holding, with its stack size as the quantity.
canevents:admin-hg-outside-bounds: You are OUTSIDE this place's bounds: a zone, spawn or loot spot set at your feet would be off the arena.
canevents:admin-hg-check-bounds-hint: The arena needs bounds: they keep the match inside and protect the blocks around it.
canevents:admin-hg-check-spawns-hint: Pedestals placed / tributes the event takes.
canevents:admin-hg-check-zone-hint: The storm zone: a circle that shrinks over the match.
canevents:admin-hg-check-loot-hint: Loot spots: chest positions filled at match start.
canevents:admin-hg-check-cornucopia-hint: Whether any loot spot uses the cornucopia tier (the rich chests in the middle).
canevents:admin-hg-help-text:
- Fastest path: stand at the arena centre and press 'Generate full layout here'.
- The zone is a circle that shrinks over the match; players outside take damage.
- Loot spots are chest positions rolled at match start; pick a tier per spot.
canevents:admin-hg-gen-hint: Stand at the arena centre, then generate: a ring of tribute spawns, the zone here, and cornucopia/mid/outer loot chests. Tune anything afterwards.
canevents:admin-hg-gen-radius-hint: Radius of the generated arena (and of the zone). Shared with the zone radius below.
canevents:admin-hg-gen-radius-bad: Layout radius '{0}' is not accepted (allowed 4-1000) - fix it before generating.
canevents:admin-hg-gen-spawns-hint:
How many pedestals the ring gets. Starts at the event's tribute cap (0 = the cap).
Fewer than the tributes that join means some share a pedestal.
canevents:admin-hg-gen-armed-warn: This overwrites {0} spawn(s) and {1} loot spot(s) - click again to confirm.
canevents:admin-hg-gen-tip: Stand at the arena centre, then generate: spawn ring, zone and loot chests in one go.
canevents:admin-hg-snap-hint:
On: each spawn/chest follows the ground surface (natural, uneven arenas).
Off: keeps your flat feet level - use for a schematic arena floor.
canevents:admin-hg-preview-hint:
Draws the storm dome (light blue), the circles each phase closes to (grey), spawns (green) and loot chests (tier colour) as particles at this arena.
Server particles: players standing nearby see them too.
canevents:admin-hg-log-generate: > generate HG layout r={0}, {1} spawns on '{2}'
canevents:admin-hg-zone-none: No zone yet: set it here or fit it to the bounds.
canevents:admin-hg-zone-radius-hint: Radius used by Apply radius and Set zone here.
canevents:admin-hg-zone-apply-hint:
Changes only the radius; the centre stays where it is.
The dome may reach past the arena bounds if you want it to.
canevents:admin-hg-zone-apply-nozone: Set the zone centre first (Set zone here or Fit to bounds).
canevents:admin-hg-zone-here-hint: Centres the zone on the block under your feet, with the radius on the left.
canevents:admin-hg-zone-fit-hint:
Centre = middle of the bounds, radius = distance to the nearest edge,
so the dome sits just inside the arena.
canevents:admin-hg-log-zone-fit: > fit HG zone to bounds on '{0}'
canevents:admin-hg-log-zone-radius: > set HG zone r={0} (centre kept) on '{1}'
canevents:admin-hg-spawns-fewer: Fewer spawns than tributes: in a full match some will share a pedestal.
canevents:admin-hg-spawn-add-hint: Adds a pedestal where you stand. 'Move here' on a row re-places that one.
canevents:admin-hg-spawn-move-hint: Moves this pedestal to where you are standing, keeping its number.
canevents:admin-hg-spawn-remove-hint: Removes it. The spawns after it shift up by one.
canevents:admin-hg-spawn-outside-hint:
This spawn sits outside the place's footprint.
It will still be used, but players start off the arena.
canevents:admin-hg-loot-tier-hint: Tier of the next loot spot you add.
canevents:admin-hg-loot-tier-free-hint: No event config to list tiers from: type the tier name (empty = default).
canevents:admin-hg-marker-tier: Tier '{0}': the block under your feet is highlighted in this colour while this card is open.
canevents:admin-hg-marker-neutral: The block under your feet is highlighted (grey) while this card is open.
canevents:admin-hg-loot-add-hint: Adds a chest spawn at the block under your feet, on the selected place.
canevents:admin-hg-loot-clear-hint: Removes every loot spot of this arena.
canevents:admin-hg-refresh-hint: Asks the server for the setup again.
canevents:admin-hg-loot-none: No loot spots yet - add some above.
canevents:admin-hg-loot-outside-hint: This chest sits outside the place's bounds.
canevents:admin-hg-loot-tp-hint: Teleports you onto this chest spot.
canevents:admin-hg-loot-retier-hint: Pick another tier for this spot.
canevents:admin-hg-loot-remove-hint: Removes this loot spot. The ones after it shift up by one.
canevents:admin-hg-cfg-hint: Stored in the event JSON; applies from the next match.
canevents:admin-hg-scoreboard-all-hint: Tributes and spectators see the player list with kills during the match.
canevents:admin-hg-scoreboard-eliminated: Living tributes don't see the list; it appears once they are out. Spectators always see it.
canevents:admin-hg-scoreboard-spectators: Only spectators who aren't in the match see the list; tributes don't, even after dying.
canevents:admin-hg-scoreboard-none-hint: Nobody sees the list during the match. The final results are still shown at the end.
canevents:admin-hg-variant-hint: Each HG variant keeps its own loot tables and phases: edit this one instead.
canevents:admin-hg-variant-dirty: Unsaved edits are lost when you switch - click again to switch anyway.
canevents:admin-hg-apply-all-hint:
On: saves these tables/phases into every Hunger Games event ({0}), so the arena plays the same loot in FFA, duo and ranked.
Off: saves only '{1}'.
canevents:admin-hg-save-hint: Sends the zone phases and loot tables to the server - both lists, whichever card you press it in.
canevents:admin-hg-reload-hint: Throws away unsaved edits and shows the config as last received from the server.
canevents:admin-hg-phases-hint:
Size is a share of the arena's zone radius, so one schedule fits every arena.
To make the dome bigger or smaller, change the arena's zone radius above.
canevents:admin-hg-phases-empty: No phases: the zone will not shrink.
canevents:admin-hg-phases-no-full: No phase is at 100%: the largest ({0}%) is treated as the full arena radius.
canevents:admin-hg-phase-end-hint: Match second this phase ends at.
canevents:admin-hg-phase-size-hint: Circle size as % of the arena's zone radius.
canevents:admin-hg-phase-dps-hint: Damage per second outside the circle.
canevents:admin-hg-phase-add-hint: Appends a phase with the values on the input line.
canevents:admin-hg-phase-apply-hint: Writes the input line into the phase picked with Edit.
canevents:admin-hg-phase-apply-none-hint: Pick a phase with Edit first.
canevents:admin-hg-phase-edit-hint: Loads this phase into the input line.
canevents:admin-hg-tiers-empty: No loot tiers: add one below.
canevents:admin-hg-tier-remove-hint: Removes the whole tier (Save config to keep it that way).
canevents:admin-hg-tier-new-hint: Name of the tier to add, e.g. cornucopia.
canevents:admin-hg-tier-name-missing: Type the new tier's name first.
canevents:admin-hg-items-empty: This tier has no items yet.
canevents:admin-hg-item-unknown: No such item or block in this game - check the code.
canevents:admin-hg-item-edit-hint: Loads this item into the input line; Add / update then overwrites it.
canevents:admin-hg-item-code-hint: Item or block code, e.g. game:bread-spelt-perfect.
canevents:admin-hg-item-add-hint: Adds the input line to this tier; an item already listed is updated instead.
canevents:admin-hg-item-held-hint:
Adds whatever you are holding to this tier, with its stack size as min/max.
Don't forget to Save config.
canevents:admin-hg-hold-first: Hold the item you want to add first.
canevents:admin-arenas-legend: Click a row to select a place for the Place and Mode setup tabs. Setup column: S spawns, B bounds, H hill, C checkpoints, Z zone, P platform, W weapon spawns; '!' means missing.
canevents:admin-arenas-new-tip: This tab only edits existing places. To build a new arena, use the New Arena tab.
canevents:admin-arenas-no-selection: Pick a place on the List tab first: click its row or its Open button.
canevents:admin-arenas-bulk-select-all-t:
Adds every place the filters show to the bulk selection.
Ctrl+click a row or use its box to add or drop one.
canevents:admin-arenas-bulk-type-tip: The type 'Select this type' looks for and the +/- buttons add or remove.
canevents:admin-arenas-bulk-select-type-: Adds every place the filters show that has the type picked on the left to the selection.
canevents:admin-arenas-filter-text-tip:
Part of a place name or id (#12 works too), any case.
Applied with the Filter button or when the list next refreshes; Enter does nothing.
canevents:admin-arenas-filter-apply-tip: Applies the search text. The tag and status lists apply at once.
canevents:admin-arenas-filter-tag-tip: Show only places with this type.
canevents:admin-arenas-filter-status-tip:
Ready: enabled, has spawns, nothing missing for its types.
Not set up: the server reports something a match still needs (see the Setup column's hover).
In use: a match is running there.
canevents:admin-arenas-bulk-add-type-tip: Adds the type picked in the dropdown to every selected place.
canevents:admin-arenas-bulk-remove-type-: Removes the type picked in the dropdown from every selected place.
canevents:admin-arenas-bulk-delete-tip: Deletes every selected place. Asks for confirmation.
canevents:admin-arenas-bulk-skipped: Places hosting a match right now are skipped.
canevents:admin-arenas-bulk-delete-quest: Delete {0} place(s)? Template builds are restored.
canevents:admin-arenas-row-box-tip: Adds the place to the bulk selection or drops it (Ctrl+click on the row does the same).
canevents:admin-arenas-row-open-tip: Selects the place and shows it on the Place tab.
canevents:admin-arenas-badge-nobounds: no bounds: /canep commands cannot target this place
canevents:admin-arenas-badge-noweapons: no weapon pickup spots: the bow spawns are off on this arena
canevents:admin-arenas-header-nobounds: No bounds: /canep commands cannot target this place.
canevents:admin-arenas-goto-tip:
Teleports you to this place: its first spawn point,
or the bounds centre if it has no spawns yet.
canevents:admin-arenas-outline-tip:
Draws this place's bounds and spawn points in the world.
Stays visible after you close this panel: press F7 and walk around.
canevents:admin-arenas-add-spawn-tip:
Adds a spawn point at your current position.
Team-based events use spawn points 1:1 to teams.
canevents:admin-arenas-disable-tip: Takes this place out of rotation without deleting it.
canevents:admin-arenas-enable-tip: Puts this place back into rotation.
canevents:admin-arenas-delete-tip: Deletes this place permanently. Asks for confirmation.
canevents:admin-arenas-delete-question: Delete this place? Template builds are restored.
canevents:admin-arenas-spawns-title: Spawn points: {0} (order assigns them to teams)
canevents:admin-arenas-spawns-none: No spawn points yet. Stand where a team should start and press +Spawn.
canevents:admin-arenas-spawns-outside-ti:
This spawn sits outside the place's footprint.
It will still be used, but players start off the arena.
canevents:admin-arenas-spawns-move-tip: Moves this team's spawn to where you are standing, keeping its number.
canevents:admin-arenas-spawns-remove-tip: Removes it. The spawns after it shift up a team.
canevents:admin-arenas-bounds-intro:
Bounds are the arena's footprint. They are not a barrier; players can walk out.
What they do: let /canep commands find this place by where you stand, give Spleef its platform size, and provide the fallback centre for KOTH / Hunger Games.
Look at opposite floor corners and mark them.
canevents:admin-arenas-mark-target-look: Next mark: the block you aimed at when you pressed F7 ({0}, {1}, {2})
canevents:admin-arenas-mark-target-feet: Next mark: the block under your feet ({0}, {1}, {2})
canevents:admin-arenas-mark-target-none: Cannot read a position right now.
canevents:admin-arenas-mark-howto: Aim at a corner, press F7, click Mark. Or stand on the corner.
canevents:admin-arenas-mark-at-feet: Mark the block under my feet
canevents:admin-arenas-mark-at-feet-tip:
Marks take the block under your feet even if you aimed at something when you opened the panel.
Handy when the corner is on the ground: no pillar needed to aim at.

canevents:admin-arenas-koth-help:
• The zone is a cylinder: radius in XZ, from 1 block below the center up to its height.
• The team that outnumbers everyone else inside scores; equal numbers score nothing.
• Add one spawn point per team (2-4 teams supported), not one per player:
  with as many spawns as players they are handed out per player and teams get split.

canevents:admin-arenas-koth-offarena: the hill would be placed off the arena.

Stand on top of the hill first: the block under your feet becomes the center,
and the zone reaches from 1 below it up to the height you set.

canevents:admin-arenas-pk-help:
• Stand on the surface block where the checkpoint should be.
• Mark next checkpoint / Mark finish: no blocks are placed, only positions saved.
• During an event an invisible trigger is spawned on each saved block.
• Indices only set the order: a match renumbers them 0, 1, 2..., gaps are fine.
canevents:admin-arenas-pk-offarena: the checkpoint would be marked off the arena.
canevents:admin-arenas-pk-mark: Mark next checkpoint (block under my feet)
canevents:admin-arenas-pk-mark-tip: Saves the block under your feet as the next checkpoint, after the course's last one.
canevents:admin-arenas-pk-finish-tip: Saves the block under your feet as the finish.
canevents:admin-arenas-pk-nofinish: No finish marked: nobody can complete the course.
canevents:admin-arenas-pk-index-hint: Set index: type the index below, then click Set index on the row.
canevents:admin-arenas-pk-set-index-tip: Gives this checkpoint the number typed in the Index field.
canevents:admin-arenas-pk-lives-unset: Lives on this arena: not set (the event's default applies)
canevents:admin-arenas-ctf-help:
• Each team needs one flag post. Post 1 belongs to team 1, post 2 to team 2.
• You score by carrying an enemy flag to your own post - but only while your own flag is still home, so a mutual steal is a stand-off.
• Killing a carrier sends the flag straight back to its post.
• Players respawn at their own team's spawn point, so add one spawn per team.
canevents:admin-arenas-ctf-none: NO FLAG POSTS SET: nobody can capture. Add one per team below.
canevents:admin-arenas-ctf-some: Only {0} of {1} posts set - a team without a post cannot capture or be captured from.
canevents:admin-arenas-ctf-all: {0} flag post(s) set - one per team.
canevents:admin-arenas-ctf-offarena: the post would be placed off the arena.
canevents:admin-arenas-ctf-team-tip: Which team the post belongs to. Team 1 is the first party in the match, and so on.
canevents:admin-arenas-ctf-set: Set the team's post at the block under my feet
canevents:admin-arenas-ctf-set-tip:
Writes the post of the team in the Team field.

canevents:admin-arenas-ctf-clear-tip: Removes every flag post of this place.
canevents:admin-arenas-spleef-edit-tip: Enters platform-edit mode: paint destructible blocks inside the place's bounds. Save to commit.
canevents:admin-arenas-block-from-hand-t: Take the block you are holding in the active hotbar slot.
canevents:admin-arenas-block-from-hand-n: Hold a block in your active hotbar slot first.
canevents:admin-arenas-spleef-fill-flood: Flood fills air blocks from your position until hitting terrain or the radius.
canevents:admin-arenas-spleef-save-tip: Commits the painted platform and leaves edit mode.
canevents:admin-arenas-spleef-cancel-tip: Throws away everything painted this session.
canevents:admin-arenas-spleef-cage-hint: Stand in the center of the desired cage, then:
canevents:admin-arenas-spleef-cage-tip: Sets the cage at your position with the size and block above.
canevents:admin-tour-new-tip: Starts an unsaved draft on the right. Save creates it on the server.
canevents:admin-tour-control-none: Pick a tournament in the list to drive it.
canevents:admin-tour-control-save-first: The draft does not exist on the server yet - save it first.
canevents:admin-tour-open-signup-tip: Players can sign up from now on.
canevents:admin-tour-close-signup-tip: Stops signups and seeds the bracket; Begin starts it.
canevents:admin-tour-call-next-tip: Calls the next pending match right away - needed when 'Start each match by hand' is on.
canevents:admin-tour-running-note: Running - follow it and declare results in the Bracket tab.
canevents:admin-tour-cancel-tip: Asks first: refund or keep the stakes, or delete it outright.
canevents:admin-tour-delete-hint: Delete leaves no history row - for ones created by mistake. Stakes are refunded first.
canevents:admin-tour-editor-none: Select a tournament on the left, or create one.
canevents:admin-tour-save-tip: Sends the whole form to the server.
canevents:admin-tour-save-create-tip: Creates the tournament on the server. It then appears in the list.
canevents:admin-tour-locked: Running or finished - configuration is locked.
canevents:admin-tour-name-tip: Shown to players in the tournament list and in chat.
canevents:admin-tour-set-teamsize-tip: 1 = solo bracket. Above 1, players sign up as a party of exactly this size.
canevents:admin-tour-set-ready-tip: Seconds each side has to accept a called match. 0 = start without asking.
canevents:admin-tour-set-manualstart-tip: Nothing is called on its own: you press 'Call next match' (Control card, or the Debug tab) when the stage is ready. For a paced, commentated event.
canevents:admin-tour-set-deadline-tip: Minutes from Save until signup closes and the bracket starts by itself. 0 = manual.
canevents:admin-tour-set-openin-tip: Minutes from Save until signup opens by itself. The tournament sits in the list as a draft until then, so players can see it coming. 0 = you open it by hand.
canevents:admin-tour-set-window-tip: How long signup stays open once it opens. Unlike the deadline this is a duration, so a repeating tournament gets the same window every time. 0 = no window.
canevents:admin-tour-set-repeat-tip: After this one ends, a fresh copy is queued with the same settings. Measured from the END, so a long bracket never overlaps its successor. 0 = one-off.
canevents:admin-tour-set-showbefore: Show to players before signup opens
canevents:admin-tour-set-showbefore-tip: On: the scheduled tournament sits in the players' list as a draft with a countdown. Off: only admins see it until signup opens, for a half-configured draft or a surprise event.
canevents:admin-tour-set-repeatat-tip: Server-local clock times, e.g. 19:00;21:30. Takes precedence over the interval - a fixed hour is something players can remember. Empty = no daily times.
canevents:admin-tour-set-autostart-tip: Starts the bracket by itself once this many have signed up. 0 = wait for an admin or the deadline. Set it to the max for the usual 'start when full'.
canevents:admin-tour-set-autostartdelay-: Breathing room between the field filling up and the first ready check. Cancelled if somebody withdraws in the meantime. Only used with auto-start.
canevents:admin-tour-set-sides-tip: How many sides meet in one bracket match. 0 = take it from the event: 2 for a duel, a whole heat for Hunger Games.
canevents:admin-tour-set-advance-tip: How many of them go through. 1 is a straight knockout; more turns each match into a qualifying heat. Requires a mode that ranks its players - Hunger Games ranks by survival.
canevents:admin-tour-set-owngear-tip: No arena kit: everyone fights with what they walked in with - and really owns it. Dying drops it like anywhere else, and nothing is handed back at the end.
canevents:admin-tour-set-lockclass: Lock class for the whole tournament
canevents:admin-tour-set-lockclass-tip: On: the class picked at signup is fixed once the bracket starts - nobody counter-picks after seeing who they drew. Off: players may switch between rounds.
canevents:admin-tour-set-pausesched-tip: Keeps the scheduler from taking the arenas or the players mid-bracket.
canevents:admin-tour-warn-repeatat: Repeat times must look like 19:00, separated by ';'.
canevents:admin-tour-warn-advance: Advance must be fewer than the sides, or nobody is ever knocked out.
canevents:admin-tour-warn-thirdplace: Third-place match only applies to two-sided brackets.
canevents:admin-tour-warn-owngear: Real stakes: gear lost in a match is gone.

canevents:admin-tour-events-off-warn: Switched off, turn on in Events: {0}
canevents:admin-tour-classes-hint: Untick to ban a class for this tournament.

canevents:admin-tour-arena-unusable-tip: Lacks the place types the chosen events need.
canevents:admin-tour-rake-tip: Burned from the pot before it is split. 0 pays everything out.

canevents:admin-tour-bracket-unsaved: The draft is not saved yet - there is no bracket.
canevents:admin-tour-bracket-too-few: Needs at least two entrants before a bracket can be shown.

canevents:admin-tour-bracket-hint: Left-click a match for details, right-click to declare a winner.

canevents:admin-tour-match-empty: Nobody is in this match yet.
canevents:admin-tour-match-dq-hint: Disqualify removes the side from the whole tournament.
canevents:admin-wizard-intro: Pick what you want to run; this walks through everything that event needs.

canevents:admin-wizard-pick-title: Already built it? Pick it from the list:

canevents:admin-wizard-bounds-hint:
Bounds are how /canep commands find the place you are standing in,
and how this mode's geometry gets attached to it.

canevents:admin-wizard-spawns-hint-hg: One pedestal per tribute. Fewer is fine: tributes then share pedestals.
canevents:admin-wizard-outside: You are standing OUTSIDE this place's bounds.
canevents:admin-wizard-spawns-extra: More spawns than teams: they will be handed out per player, which splits teams across separate corners.
